Full Bore Release.name: Full Bore Release
Full Bore Release.description: The user braces against solid cover and charges for two turns, with a rising whine and bright muzzle, then fires within sixty meters. The round deals massive bludgeoning damage and breaks vehicle armor; held back, it knocks one adult down with a broad blunt round. The recoil throws an unbraced user down, and the burned arm cannot fire for the rest of the scene. Strain: severe.
